HAMMER_MOD_KEYWORD_CHARGE.title: Charge
HAMMER_MOD_KEYWORD_CHARGE.description: Charge persists between turns. Unblocked damage normally clears all Charge, but some effects can prevent this.
HAMMER_MOD_KEYWORD_CHARGE_RELEASE.title: Release Charge
HAMMER_MOD_KEYWORD_CHARGE_RELEASE.descri: After this card finishes all of its releases, clear all Charge unless another effect prevents it.
HAMMER_MOD_KEYWORD_STUN.title: Stun
HAMMER_MOD_KEYWORD_STUN.description: When an enemy's Stun reaches its current threshold, it becomes Stunned. Each time it is Stunned, its next threshold doubles.
